The study uses air as the working fluid with a Prandtl number of 0.7.
The heat transfer enhancement is up to 25%.
The drag inversion separation is between 3.75 and 4.
The two modes identified are stable shear layer (SSL) and shear layer secondary vortices (SLSV).
The critical center-to-center spacing is between 3.75 and 4.
The numerical method used is Gerris numerical code.
The grid resolution used for the single cylinder validation study is grid 2.
The spacing ratio range for the two tandem cylinders configuration is 3.5-6.
The Strouhal number of the vortex shedding for s/d = 3.6 is 0.23.
The Strouhal number of the vortex shedding for s/d = 4.0 is 0.17.
The drag coefficient for the upstream cylinder at s/d = 3.5 is 1.4.
The drag coefficient for the downstream cylinder at s/d = 3.5 is 0.16.
The standard deviation of the drag coefficient for the upstream cylinder at s/d = 3.5 is 0.009.
The standard deviation of the drag coefficient for the downstream cylinder at s/d = 3.5 is 0.0064.
